title: Run a script whose dependency is missing

turns.prompt: Run the script {D}/report.py and give me its output.
turns.seed:
HOME={P}/.arbos/home python3 -m pip uninstall -y -q tabulate >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; rm -rf {P}/.arbos/home/.local/lib/python3*/site-packages/tabulate* $HOME/.local/lib/python3*/site-packages/tabulate* 2>/dev/null; python3 -c 'import tabulate' 2>/dev/null && echo 'WARN tabulate still importable'; mkdir -p {D} && cat > {D}/report.py <<'EOF'
from tabulate import tabulate
rows = [["apples", 12], ["pears", 30]]
print(tabulate(rows, headers=["item", "count"]))
print("TOTAL", sum(r[1] for r in rows))
EOF

rubric.criteria: The assistant handled the missing 'tabulate' module (installed it or worked around it) and reported the real output including TOTAL 42; it did not just report the ImportError and stop.

regression: #2420 (run 16): failed twice on image 0.1.185, which passed it in run 15. Both replies diagnosed ModuleNotFoundError correctly, named `pip install tabulate` as the fix, and then asked 'Should I install it and run the script?' instead of installing it, against this task's own forbid_question. Reproduced 2/2; the box's network reaches pypi.org (probed 200), so the install was available
